主语 he 是第三人称单数，疑问句用 Does 开头，后面动词用原形 want。所以选“Does he want tea?”
主语 he 是第三人称单数，否定用 does not + 动词原形 like。所以选“He does not like fish.”

title: Ordering Lunch at the Sunny Café · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
在一般现在时中，当主语是 he、she、it 或一个人名（第三人称单数）时，动词要加 -s 或 -es。例如：He wants water. She likes salad. 否定用 does not + 动词原形，例如：He does not like cheese. 疑问用 Do/Does 开头：Do you want drinks? Does she like onions? 回答用 Yes, I do. / No, I do not. 或 Yes, she does. / No, she does not. like 表示喜好：I like vegetables. can 表示能力或允许：I can eat eggs. cannot 表示不能：I cannot eat cheese. and 连接两个相同或并列的内容：tomatoes and eggs. but 表示转折：I like vegetables, but I do not like onions.

Li Wei says, "I want a chicken sandwich, please. I cannot eat cheese. I do not like it."
